name: BRASS ADORNMENTS
text: Once per battle each, ANIMALISTIC FURY and WILD RAGE cost 0 CP.

name: GORE MARKS
text: Once per turning point, when a friendly Fellgor Ravager fights or retaliates, you may deal it 1 damage and re-roll one of its attack dice; if the re-rolled die is a fail, it takes 1 more damage.

name: CHAOS SIGIL
text: Once per turning point, when an operative shoots a friendly Fellgor Ravager, at the start of the Roll Defence Dice step you may lower that weapon's Piercing x by 1 until the end of the sequence (Piercing 1 is ignored).

name: WAR PAINT
text: Friendly Fellgor Ravagers ignore the Move loss from being injured (the Hit penalty still applies), whether the injury is real or the Frenzy one.
